hooks.name: log-tool-usage
hooks.description: Log every tool call to .beacon/tool-usage.log for AgentOS self-monitoring

hooks.name: verify-build-on-write
hooks.description: After any Write or Edit to .go files, run go build to catch errors early

hooks.name: verify-types-on-tsx-write
hooks.description: After any Write or Edit to .tsx files, run type-check

hooks.name: session-end-summary
hooks.description: At end of every session, write a summary of what was built
hooks.command: echo "[SESSION END $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] Session complete. Check PLAN.md and TEST_REPORT.md for details." >> .beacon/sessions.log
